records.title: Abhilekh Patal — digital archive
records.summary: Search the National Archives of India's catalogue and digitised holdings, including records on Company expansion, colonial administration and the freedom struggle.
records.details: Search by series, call number, creator, subject or accession number. Some records have catalogue descriptions but are not yet digitised; availability varies.

records.title: Public records & record holdings
records.summary: Browse descriptions of record series preserved by the National Archives, including Foreign, Military, Home, Finance and States records.
records.details: The holdings guide identifies record series by department and year range. It helps researchers locate likely collections before searching the digital portal or visiting the research room.

records.title: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Papers
records.summary: Access officially released and declassified file collections relating to Subhas Chandra Bose.
records.details: Read file descriptions and dates carefully; an individual file is evidence of its contents, not necessarily a complete account of an event.

records.title: Constituent Assembly debates
records.summary: Read digitised Constituent Assembly Draft Making and Legislative Debates in the Parliament Digital Library.
records.details: Draft-making debates and legislative debates are separate collections; check the collection and sitting date before citing.

records.country: India · Ministry of Law and Justice
records.title: The Constitution of India
records.summary: Read the official text of the Constitution on the Legislative Department website.
records.details: The official text records commencement on 26 January 1950 and the repeal of the Indian Independence Act 1947 and Government of India Act 1935.

records.title: Gandhi chronology & documents
records.summary: Explore the day-by-day event chronology, writings, journals, photographs and materials on Gandhi's life and movements.
records.details: The chronology is based on C. B. Dalal's day-to-day account and includes sections for marches, imprisonments, tours and satyagrahas.

records.title: Salt Satyagraha & Dandi March
records.summary: Explore the Dandi March background, marchers, route chronology and post-march events.
records.details: The portal organises Salt Satyagraha material into researchable sections. Use the detailed chronology for day-level dates.

records.title: Freedom struggle & imprisonment chronology
records.summary: Explore Nehru's participation in the freedom movement, imprisonment periods and related biographical material.
records.details: The portal records involvement from the Bankipore Congress session and lists the dates and durations of Nehru's prison terms.

records.title: Unsung Heroes of India's freedom struggle
records.summary: Browse freedom-fighter profiles with state and district filters, including regional and lesser-known participants.
records.details: The Ministry of Culture describes this as a compilation of freedom-struggle profiles. Coverage varies by person and region.

records.title: Digital District Repository
records.summary: Explore districtwise narratives connecting local heritage and freedom movement events to wider Indian history.
records.details: The repository documents local histories by district and can help identify people, places and events not present in national chronologies.

records.title: Indian independence — original documents, part two
records.summary: Read transcripts and inspect documents about the 3 June Plan, partition, population movement and the immediate aftermath.
records.details: The teaching collection includes catalogued documents with file references, transcripts and downloadable sources. Contemporary perspectives should be read as situated records.

records.title: Indian independence — context and documents, part one
records.summary: Use the first National Archives teaching collection for background documents on the independence and partition process.
records.details: The collection supports historical enquiry through selected primary documents and transcripts. Compare authors, dates, intended audiences and institutional positions.

records.title: Indian Independence Act 1947
records.summary: Explore Parliament's historical guide to the legislation that created the two Dominions and set out the legal transfer.
records.details: For exact legal wording, use the enacted text on the official legislation record. The Parliament guide provides background on the Act and its place in the end of British rule.
